content: पिञ्जल {%a.%} [पिञ्ज् कलच्] .²1 Overcome with grief or terror, extremely confounded or perplexed. .²2 Panic-struck (as an army). .{@-लम्@} .²1 Yellow orpiment. .²2 The leaf of the Kuśa grass. .{@-ली@} Two blades of Kuśa grass used in holding certain articles at a sacrifice; एतदेव पिञ्जल्या लक्ष्णं समुदाहृतम् <ls>Karmapradīpa.</ls>
